## Summary
The first real connector on the P04.1 eight-stage framework (§23.2): `osm` ingests `man_made=surveillance` **nodes, ways and relations** from OpenStreetMap and lands them in the physically separate **ODbL** asset layer under the REFERENCE custody posture (§42.3, ADR-011). Implements the spec `docs/tickets/P04.2__osm-connector.md`.

- **Versioned tag→claim vocabulary (SIG-INGEST-045)** as data (`data/osm_tag_vocab.toml`, §20 migrations): allowlisted keys → predicates, `;` multi-values split as **unordered sets**, `surveillance:type`→device-kind, `camera:type`→mobility. A surveillance-bearing key **or value** outside the allowlist becomes an **unmapped value + a research task** (REQ-R1-02); `raw_value` always preserved (P2).
- **`(osm_type, osm_id, version)` keying (SIG-INGEST-045b/045f)** — id-space-scoped subject; version preserved on every asset row so a later OSM edit is detectable (REQ-R1-01).
- **`first_observed` walked from element history (SIG-INGEST-045a/045c)** — the version where surveillance tags first appeared, **never** the creation timestamp; left unresolved (`None`) rather than a creation-date fallback in the snapshot path.
- **Deletion via snapshot diffing (SIG-INGEST-045g)** — a *deletion from OSM* is a **mapping event**, kept strictly distinct from a *street removal* (a world event the connector never infers from a diff).
- **Mapper-identity discard (SIG-INGEST-045e)** — OSM `user`/`uid` dropped at ingest, never stored/exposed; `changeset` retained.
- **Overpass etiquette (SIG-INGEST-045d/h/i/j)** — descriptive contact UA via the shared `PoliteFetcher`; no-space tag filters + `[timeout]/[maxsize]`; `429`→back-off / `504`→shrink; PBF-for-bulk vs tiled-Overpass-for-increments; no worldwide bbox-stitching; no unpermitted self-hosted instances.
- **ODbL landing (SIG-ONTO-007, SIG-LIC-006)** — every row stamped `ODbL-1.0`/`osm_physical`; the licence gate fails any export that mixes the OSM layer with the CC-BY graph. Committed fixtures + a structural-drift **canary** (SIG-PARSE-007/008).

## What changed
- `connectors/src/connectors/osm.py` — `OSMConnector` (eight stages) + pure helpers (keying, mapper-identity strip, `;`-split, `first_observed_from_history`, `snapshot_diff`, Overpass etiquette, unmapped→task, `physical_asset_rows` projection, `canary_findings`).
- `connectors/src/connectors/data/osm_tag_vocab.toml` — the versioned vocabulary (data, not code).
- `connectors/src/connectors/__init__.py`, `cli.py` — self-register on import; CLI `list-connectors` now lists `osm`.
- `tests/connectors/test_osm.py` (28 tests) + `tests/connectors/fixtures/osm/*.json` (Overpass snapshot, element history, deletion snapshot).
- `docs/adr/ADR-027*`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/traceability.md`, `docs/risk_register.md`.

## Design decisions / deferrals (ADR-027)
- Vocabulary is versioned **data**; the ODbL "separate table" is realised at the connector layer (compartment stamp + projection + export gate) because connectors are not DB-wired yet.
- Overpass `429/504` semantics ship as connector helpers; reconciling the shared `PoliteFetcher` (which today classifies 429 as a challenge) + the OCFL `CaptureStore` adapter + a live HTTP transport are the live-wiring ticket — **RISK-P4-06**. A physically separate ODbL DB table per §42.3 is **RISK-P4-07**. Both are out of P04.2 scope ("the connector framework itself — P04.1").
